prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Post-Setup Desktop Companion Control Sheet: Adds a dedicated desktop pet interaction quick guide screen right after the home intro to show tray shortcuts and controls before onboarding completes. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding, and completion drops to 64.8% at finish.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Angle Photo Verification Checklist Flow: Replaces standard single photo upload with a guided multi-angle photo checklist flow for custom pets. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or producing visually glitched pet renders.)
2: [home, redesign] Live Render Stage Background Spotlight: Redesigns the waiting screen layout into a stage view with visual asset rendering animations. (why: Waiting step mean time is extremely long (2336s) and 14% drop off before reaching home intro.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Previous Pet Profile Sync Safety Callout: Displays an explicit account verification notice guaranteeing that existing pet save files will be merged cleanly without resetting. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Startup Status Checklist Bar: Adds explicit step-by-step startup progress details during asset rendering on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step has a median duration of 201s and high variance, leaving users unsure if progress is ongoing.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Instant Setup Time Commitment Headline: Replaces choose_path copy to explicitly set expectations that setup takes under 2 minutes. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating users pause or delay choosing a path.)
6: [home, notification] Background Download Ready OS Toast Prompt: Enables OS desktop notifications when background pet rendering finishes so users can minimize the app. (why: Mean time in waiting screen is 2336s (38 minutes), indicating users minimize or abandon the window while rendering.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop System Tray Visibility Directions: Clarifies home intro messaging with precise instructions on where to locate the desktop pet in the tray bar. (why: 3 support mails cited pet not showing on desktop or app not opening, and 35.2% abandon during/after finish.)
